name: @mansoldev/framework
description: A modern CSS framework powered by Sass and PostCSS.

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['dist', 'docs', 'temp'].forEach(path => fs.rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true }))"
scripts.build:framework: pnpm exec vite build --config vite.config.framework.js && node scripts/build-themes.js
scripts.build:website: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src=path.resolve('dist','framework.css'); const dest=path.resolve('website','public','framework.css'); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest),{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync(src,dest);" && pnpm exec astro build --root website && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src=path.resolve('website','dist'); const dest=path.resolve('docs'); fs.rmSync(dest,{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.cpSync(src,dest,{recursive:true}); fs.rmSync(src,{recursive:true,force:true});"
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:framework && pnpm run build:website
